title: Spotify Playlist & Podcast Change Monitor
description: Monitor public Spotify playlists, albums, artist top tracks, podcasts, and episodes. Detect additions, removals, reorders, and newly featured content with named watchlists, changed-only delivery, CSV reports, and up to 50 nested tracks included in one parent charge.
